source_title: Grass from Road Verges as a Substrate for Biogas Production
material: Fresh non-ensiled roadside/verge and median grass
method: Crude-fiber assay after acid and alkali treatment using FibreBag system
applicability: Seasonal Polish urban road-verge comparator; dominant species Lolium perenne with Poa pratensis and Festuca rubra.
limitations: Analytical triplicates are not independent sites. This assay overlaps structural carbohydrates and must not be added to cellulose, hemicellulose, or lignin in a mass closure. Not a GreenHub/VARTA measurement.
